NOTIFY-004.summary: Every notification, digest, invitation and reminder is sent from the configured no-reply address, or from RER's assigned verified sender on Managed hosting, and marked auto-generated; Pencil still ingests no inbound mail.
NOTIFY-004.was: Every notification, digest, invitation and reminder is sent from the configured no-reply address and marked auto-generated, so response notifications and digests require a plain noreply@ or no-reply@ sender.
NOTIFY-004.now: The same, except that on Managed hosting RER's assigned verified relay sender is the sending address for notifications and digests too; the relay marks every message auto-generated. SendGrid and Resend installations keep the plain noreply@ or no-reply@ requirement.

proseChanges.now: Managed hosting sends mail through the RER relay with no provider account or API key; Free and Assisted keep SendGrid or Resend, and direct Cloudflare deployment needs your own provider, verified sender and key. Install uses rer 0.2.24.

migrations.buyerSteps: Add the refreshed Base import kit's preparation checkpoints, stream sources and erasure progress records. publicReleaseNotes:
Pencil 0.5.0 sends Managed hosting mail through the RER relay: a Managed installation needs no SendGrid or Resend account or API key. Free and Assisted installations keep the ordinary SendGrid or Resend choices, and direct Cloudflare hosting still needs your own verified sender and provider key.

Pencil pins rer 0.2.24, whose maintained mail adapter (since 0.2.23) fixes sign-in and invitation delivery from Cloudflare Workers. A relay redirect is refused rather than followed, rate-limited notifications retry on schedule, and a rejected notification shows the owner a plain explanation. The relay carries one recipient, text and optional HTML; a response notification with a saved inline logo cannot be sent through it and its delivery problem stays visible on Results.

On Managed hosting, response notifications and Daily digests also send through the relay from RER's assigned verified sender. With SendGrid or Resend they still need a plain noreply@ or no-reply@ sender.

RER's Open app link and a local Lobby's Sign in link fill in the sign-in email from login_hint, validated by Base. A hosted Lobby never names its owner. /health reports the built source, release digest and Worker version on Managed hosting.

Migration 0037 is additive: it adds the refreshed Base import kit's preparation checkpoints, stream sources and erasure progress, all kept in backups.

Upgrading a local install: stop dev, create the ignored exports folder (mkdir -p exports), export to exports/before-upgrade.rer, pull, then run rer install, rer setup and rer dev.

Screenshot: .github/assets/release/pencil-0.5.0-results-1440.png (Results at 1440 px, local dev with sample responses).

The relay path was proved against Base's adapter and a native Worker build, not by live inbox delivery. This release does not claim hosted capacity beyond the measured ceiling or live mail delivery.
agentUpdateInstructions: Read OPERATIONS.md, docs/FIRST-RELEASE.md, docs/HOSTING.md and docs/production-mail.md. Export first to a private path outside source paths or in this checkout's ignored exports directory (create it with mkdir -p exports; rer export refuses a missing folder), and verify recovery into a new local database or an explicitly selected empty migrated D1 database. Preserve every applied migration's bytes, including 0019 as your database applied it (migrations/released-rewrites.json), and apply 0037 after 0036 before serving the new source: locally with rer setup (rer dev also applies pending migrations before it serves), and hosted with rer deploy. MAIL_PROVIDER rer requires MAIL_RELAY_URL (an absolute HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment) and the RER-supplied MAIL_API_KEY; keep resend or sendgrid with your own key and verified sender for direct hosting. On Managed hosting (MAIL_PROVIDER rer) response notifications and Daily digests use RER's assigned verified sender; keep the plain noreply@ or no-reply@ sender rule for SendGrid and Resend. Never transmit Pencil's private X-Pencil queue headers to the relay, never follow a relay redirect, and never replay historical or imported mail. /signin prefills only from login_hint; never look up an operator's email for anonymous visitors, and keep the Lobby's hint to loopback origins with exactly one active owner. Keep SETUP_TOKEN unset after the owner claim. Run the populated 0.4.0 predecessor upgrade test and the complete verification gate on the integrated source.
